♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon has moved deeper into sidereal Pisces, still in your 12th house, but edging toward conjunction with Rahu by sign, stirring subconscious restlessness and unusual dreams. Jupiter, ruler of Pisces, sits in Cancer in your 4th, tying this inner churn to questions of emotional security and family. The Sun with retrograde Mercury in Virgo continues to activate your 6th house of work, health and service, while Mars, your ruler, is still in late Cancer, pushing you to act from the heart rather than from impulse. This is a day of subtle inner rewiring rather than obvious fireworks.

💼 Career: The Virgo Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 6th keeps your mind on systems, co-workers and practical problem-solving, but the Pisces Moon in the 12th shows that part of you is tired of doing things the same old way. You may notice a quiet urge to step away from busy work and look at the structure of your days from a distance. If you can, protect pockets of undisturbed time for research, planning, or finishing something that’s been pending for weeks. You’re likely to be sharper at spotting hidden inefficiencies, especially in digital tools, schedules or delegation patterns.

❤️ Love: With Jupiter linking your 4th and 12th houses, old emotional stories around home and belonging may surface in relationships. If partnered, you might see more clearly how early family patterns still influence how you ask for support—or avoid doing so. A simple, heartfelt admission like “I’m more tired than I’ve been letting on” can soften tension. If single, your attraction today is more to people who feel emotionally safe than to flashy chemistry. Someone who offers calm presence, even in a quiet message or thoughtful reply, can stand out.

💰 Money: Virgo in your 6th favours reviewing recurring expenses tied to work habits: software subscriptions, transport, snacks, or services you keep “for convenience.” The Moon in the 12th can exaggerate the feeling that money is slipping away, but rather than panicking, use this as a nudge to identify one or two leaks and gently close them. With Mars energising your 4th, there may be family or housing-related costs; prioritise what stabilises your base instead of reactive or guilt-driven spending.

🧘 Advice: Treat today as a strategic pause. Step back from constant output long enough to notice where your energy actually wants to go next.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The quiet choice you make about what you will no longer pour energy into becomes the first brick in your next chapter.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon continues its journey through sidereal Pisces in your 11th house of circles, allies and long-range aspirations, now subtly interacting with Rahu by sign and stirring unusual social currents—online or offline. Jupiter in Cancer in your 3rd rules this Moon, making conversations, messages and short trips especially meaningful. The Sun with retrograde Mercury in Virgo still energises your 5th house of creativity and personal expression, while Venus, your ruler, in Libra in your 6th keeps you tuned to balance in work and health. Your energy is pulled between refining what you love and finding the right people to share it with.

💼 Career: The Virgo 5th-house emphasis supports editing, polishing and re-framing creative or specialist work: a presentation, design, training, or proposal that carries your personal stamp. The Pisces Moon in your 11th highlights how that work lands with groups—teams, audiences, communities. Today favours small but meaningful outreach: reconnecting with a former collaborator, floating a revised idea in a trusted group, or soft-launching something to a limited audience for feedback. Be open to unusual or international connections; Rahu’s influence can bring opportunities from unexpected quarters.

❤️ Love: With your 5th and 11th houses lit up, friendship and romance can overlap. If partnered, you may feel drawn to do something slightly different together—try a class, attend a gathering, or brainstorm a shared project. Seeing your partner interact with others can remind you of what you initially admired. If single, someone in your wider network—through social media, professional associations, or a friend of a friend—could catch your attention. Notice who genuinely engages with your ideas rather than just your appearance.

💰 Money: The 11th house relates to gains from effort, bonuses and client referrals. Pisces here can blur timelines, so income might feel more like “waves” than fixed numbers right now. Use today to review how your creative or specialised skills (5th house) are actually being monetised through networks (11th house): are you visible to the right people? Venus in your 6th invites practical tweaks—pricing, packaging, or scheduling—that make your offerings easier to say yes to without increasing your workload dramatically.

🧘 Advice: Give your future a concrete gesture today—an email, a draft, a conversation—that brings one of your long-held ideas a step closer to reality.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The person who casually encourages your talent today may be mirroring back a path you’ve secretly wanted for years.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon’s continued passage through sidereal Pisces at the top of your chart emphasises your 10th house of status, duty and public role. Jupiter in Cancer in your 2nd rules this Moon, blending career concerns with questions of income and self-worth. The Sun tightly conjoined retrograde Mercury—your ruler—in Virgo in your 4th keeps home, roots and emotional foundations under review. You stand at an energetic crossroads where inner rearrangements are already starting to alter how others perceive you.

💼 Career: A 10th-house Pisces Moon opens space for more intuitive leadership. You may sense unspoken dynamics in your workplace—who feels left out, who needs guidance, where a project is drifting. With your ruler retrograde at the Sun’s heart in your 4th, it’s an excellent moment to rethink how your living situation or family routines support your ambitions: workspace conditions, working hours, or boundaries between domestic and professional life. A key insight might be that stability at home allows bolder moves outside; let that guide small but concrete adjustments.

❤️ Love: The axis of 4th and 10th houses highlights how you juggle private and public selves in relationships. If partnered, questions like “How much of our life is shaped by my work?” or “How do we want our home to feel given our career paths?” may arise. A practical but kind conversation about roles and responsibilities—especially around childcare or household logistics—can go surprisingly well. If single, you may feel drawn to someone who understands your professional drive yet appreciates your softer, more domestic side. Encounters linked to property, family events or career settings are favoured.

💰 Money: Jupiter ruling your 10th from the 2nd joins the dots between reputation and earnings. You might reflect on whether your current job title or public identity truly matches the value you bring. Today favours revisiting salary structures, fee levels or the way you present your skills, not necessarily to demand immediate change, but to define what would feel fair. The Virgo 4th-house emphasis may also highlight home-related costs; look for ways to improve comfort that don’t overextend you.

🧘 Advice: Let your idea of “success” today include how you feel when you walk through your own front door.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: A subtle shift in how you organise your home base can quietly raise the ceiling on what you believe is possible in your career.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, is still in sidereal Pisces, flowing through your 9th house of higher perspective, belief and long-distance horizons. Jupiter in Cancer in your 1st rules this Moon, giving you a potent mix of sensitivity and philosophical curiosity. The Sun with retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 3rd keeps your everyday mind busy—calls, messages, local matters—while Mars in your sign adds assertiveness and a touch of impatience. Your energy is best used stretching beyond habitual thinking rather than fighting small battles.

💼 Career: With the 9th and 3rd houses activated, today favours teaching, training, legal or academic work, and any task that requires connecting details to a bigger picture. You may feel a nudge to revisit a course, certification, or content strategy that could open doors later. Conversations with mentors, teachers or colleagues from different backgrounds can bring key insights. If work feels cramped, consider whether a change in schedule, commute or communication habits could make your days more spacious, even before any major external shift.

❤️ Love: The 9th-house Moon prompts you to seek meaning in your relationships, not just familiarity. If partnered, you might naturally slide into deeper topics—values, spiritual beliefs, or dreams for the future beyond practical plans. Shared learning—a documentary, a workshop, a book—can be oddly bonding now. If single, you’re likely drawn to people who broaden your world: travellers, thinkers, or those with a very different life story. Pay attention less to instant comfort and more to whether their worldview resonates with your evolving sense of truth.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 1st can bring optimism about future possibilities, though Mars in your sign might push you toward quick moves. The Virgo 3rd-house Sun–Mercury retrograde period is better suited to research than to bold financial leaps: reading fine print, comparing offers, learning more about an investment or educational expense. The 9th-house Moon favours spending on knowledge and perspective—courses, books, mentoring—provided it’s grounded in a realistic plan.

🧘 Advice: Let curiosity lead today, especially when you catch yourself reacting strongly; ask what belief sits underneath that reaction.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: One genuine question you ask—of a person, a book or yourself—can do more to change your path than a dozen forced decisions.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon continues to transit sidereal Pisces in your 8th house of shared resources, emotional intensity and deep transformation. Jupiter in Cancer in your 12th rules this Moon, pulling your focus toward what’s hidden: unconscious motivations, private fears and behind-the-scenes entanglements. The Sun—your ruler—travels with retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 2nd house of income and values. Today’s energy highlights the link between your material choices and deeper emotional patterns.

💼 Career: The 8th–2nd house axis lights up themes of power and value at work. You may become more aware of how dependencies—on a boss, a client, a partner, or a system—shape your professional options. With Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 2nd, this is an excellent time to scrutinise how your role is defined: job description, KPIs, revenue share, or unspoken expectations. You’re not being asked to stage a revolt; instead, look for one area where you can renegotiate terms or change your approach so that what you contribute feels more proportionally recognised.

❤️ Love: An 8th-house Moon in Pisces amplifies emotional undercurrents in relationships. If partnered, you might sense where trust feels strong and where it’s a bit fragile—around money, privacy, or emotional availability. This is a good day to gently name one tender topic rather than trying to fix everything at once. If single, you may find yourself drawn to intense, soulful people or to conversations that quickly go beneath the surface. Let curiosity guide you, but keep your sense of self steady; you don’t need to merge with someone to feel close.

💰 Money: With the Sun and retrograde Mercury in your 2nd, practical finances are already under review: budgeting, income streams, and spending aligned with your priorities. The Pisces Moon in the 8th brings attention to debts, taxes, inheritances and shared accounts. You might uncover a forgotten subscription, a fee structure you’d misunderstood, or an arrangement that no longer feels fair. Rather than reacting, lay out the facts and decide where clarity or a new boundary is needed. Avoid taking on new joint obligations without full information.

🧘 Advice: Notice where your body tightens when topics of money, commitment or dependence come up—that’s where gentle honesty can free you.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The boundary you set around one shared resource today is less about the numbers and more about finally honouring your own worth.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon continues through sidereal Pisces in your 7th house of partnerships, now in a looser but meaningful dance with Rahu by sign, bringing surprising interactions or shifts in expectations with others. Jupiter in Cancer in your 11th rules this Moon, expanding the role of friends and networks in your one-to-one dynamics. Meanwhile, the Sun sits with retrograde Mercury—your ruler—in Virgo in your 1st house, highlighting a turning point in self-understanding. Today the mirror that partnerships provide is particularly revealing.

💼 Career: Client relationships, contracts and collaborations are front and centre. Pisces in your 7th can blur boundaries or bring idealisation, while your Virgo planets in the 1st push for precision. You may recognise where you’ve over-customised your efforts for others or taken on more responsibility than the agreement reflects. This is a favourable day to revisit terms, timelines or scope with a tone of refinement rather than confrontation. Rahu’s involvement suggests that an unconventional ally or a new kind of partnership could appear—stay open but vet carefully.

❤️ Love: With your 7th house lit, relationship dynamics are highlighted, but not in the same way as yesterday. The Sun–Mercury cazimi in your sign brings a moment of clarity about what you actually need to feel respected and relaxed in love. If partnered, your partner’s moods may feel amplified; listen with empathy, but also notice where you automatically go into fixing mode. Experiment with simply sharing your truth rather than immediately offering solutions. If single, you might attract someone who sees your thoughtful nature as a strength rather than a quirk; trust your observation skills if something feels off beneath the charm.

💰 Money: The Virgo 1st-house emphasis can bring a desire to clean up finances and practical commitments across the board. The Pisces Moon in the 7th points directly to shared expenses and financial arrangements in business or personal partnerships. It’s a good day to check whether verbal agreements match the numbers, and to gently request documentation or clarification where needed. Don’t rush to sign new deals; instead, refine the structure so it feels balanced for all parties.

🧘 Advice: Allow yourself to be seen as you actually are now, not as the endlessly adaptable version of you others may be used to.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The moment you stop over-accommodating in one key relationship, you create space for a more honest—and ultimately kinder—connection.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in sidereal Pisces continues to activate your 6th house of daily work, routines and health, with Jupiter in Cancer in your 10th overseeing the link between small efforts and public reputation. The Sun joined with retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 12th house turns your awareness inward, to unfinished matters, hidden worries and the need for quiet processing. Venus, your ruler, in Libra in your 1st still lends grace and charm, but today you may prefer to use that grace to tidy, streamline and close loops rather than to socialise widely.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for behind-the-scenes productivity. The 6th-house Moon increases sensitivity to the emotional climate at work; you’ll sense immediately where miscommunication or neglected tasks are draining the team. With Sun–Mercury retrograde in your 12th, you’re well-placed to identify outdated processes, redundant reports or obligations that no longer serve a clear purpose. You might quietly rework a system, archive old files, or create a simple check-list that prevents recurring issues. Even if no-one notices today, Jupiter in your 10th suggests these small acts can boost your reputation over time as someone who makes things run better.

❤️ Love: Your romantic energy is somewhat introspective. If partnered, you or your partner may be more preoccupied than usual with work or private concerns. Instead of taking withdrawal personally, create a gentle, restful atmosphere and offer space without withdrawing your warmth. Honest but light sharing—“Here’s what’s on my mind right now”—may be more useful than heavy emotional debriefs. If single, you’re likely to be more discerning about where you place your attention. You might find yourself quietly stepping back from connections that feel draining or unclear.

💰 Money: The 6th house connects to income from your efforts and everyday expenses. Pisces here can bring small, easily overlooked costs: snacks, apps, minor medical or wellness items, contributions to co-workers. The Virgo 12th-house emphasis suggests there may also be dormant subscriptions, forgotten fees, or charitable giving done more from obligation than intention. A calm, compassionate review of outgoings, especially recurring ones, can reveal one or two easy adjustments that immediately lighten pressure.

🧘 Advice: Make room in your schedule today not just to do tasks, but to gently retire the ones that have reached their natural end.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The invisible work you do to simplify your life now becomes the silent foundation for the balance you crave later.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon keeps moving through sidereal Pisces in your 5th house of creativity, children, joy and heartfelt expression, still under the rulership of Jupiter in Cancer in your 9th. This links play with purpose and invites you to treat your passions as part of your larger path. Mars, your traditional ruler, in Cancer in that same 9th house adds eagerness to explore, teach or advocate for what you believe. The Sun with retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 11th turns your analytical eye toward friendships and long-term plans.

💼 Career: The combination of 5th and 11th house activation favours creative leadership and strategic networking. You may feel ready to float a bold idea in a group setting, propose a new angle for a project, or suggest a more meaningful direction for a team. With Mercury retrograde, it’s a good day for revising proposals, reshaping group goals or reconnecting with mentors and allies from your past. Don’t underestimate a casual conversation today; someone in your network may offer an opening that lines up unusually well with your deeper interests.

❤️ Love: The 5th-house Moon brings a naturally romantic, expressive tone, but Pisces makes it more soulful than dramatic. If partnered, prioritise simple pleasures that let you both relax into each other’s company—music, art, a favourite spot, playful banter. Deeper topics about direction and belief may emerge spontaneously; let them, but keep the vibe exploratory rather than forensic. If single, you’re especially magnetic when you’re immersed in something you genuinely love—creative work, study, or a cause. Encounters through shared interests, classes or community events are highlighted.

💰 Money: The 5th house touches speculative ventures and discretionary spending, while the 11th deals with gains and community-based resources. Today is better for brainstorming new income ideas connected to your talents or causes than for high-risk moves. You might identify a way to monetise a skill within a group you already belong to. Beware of emotional spending on friends or group activities from a fear of missing out; choose experiences that truly nourish you rather than buying connection.

🧘 Advice: Take seriously the activities that light you up; they’re not distractions from your path, they’re signals of it.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The moment you allow your joy to have a legitimate place in your long-term plans, your next step stops feeling forced.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon continues its passage through sidereal Pisces in your 4th house of home, inner life and emotional foundations, ruled by your planet Jupiter in Cancer in the 8th. This is an introspective, depth-oriented combination that brings private feelings to the surface. Meanwhile, the Sun fused with retrograde Mercury in Virgo shines at the top of your chart in the 10th, emphasising career reflection and public responsibilities. You’re navigating the contrast between what the world sees and what your heart actually needs.

💼 Career: With the Sun–Mercury combo in your 10th, you may be revisiting decisions about roles, leadership, visibility or long-term direction. The Pisces Moon in the 4th suggests that professional choices that ignore your emotional and domestic reality will feel increasingly untenable. Use today to gather data and impressions rather than to make irrevocable moves: observe which tasks drain you even when they look impressive, and which ones quietly feel right. A conversation with a family member or someone who has known you for years can provide helpful perspective on what truly suits you.

❤️ Love: The 4th-house Moon heightens your need for comfort and emotional safety. If partnered, you may crave time at home together, or at least a more nurturing tone in your interactions. Discussions about living arrangements, family boundaries, or how each of you finds rest could be significant now. If single, you might feel less social but more attuned to what “home” in a relationship would actually mean for you. Memories of past partners or childhood impressions of love may surface; use them as information, not as blueprints.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 8th keeps themes of shared finances, debts, inheritances and long-term planning in the background. The 4th-house Moon links these to property and family patterns: mortgages, rent, joint assets, or financial habits you’ve absorbed from relatives. The Virgo 10th-house emphasis is practical—review how your current career trajectory supports or strains your financial commitments at home. You might decide to stabilise one area before expanding in another.

🧘 Advice: Before saying yes to extra responsibility, ask whether your inner and home life have the structure needed to hold it.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Strength for you now is not in taking on more, but in aligning what you carry with the life you actually want to live.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon continues through sidereal Pisces in your 3rd house of communication, learning and day-to-day environment, under the guidance of Jupiter in Cancer in your 7th. This emphasises the relational tone of your conversations and agreements. Saturn, your ruler, still asks for maturity in how you handle information and commitments. The Sun partnered with retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 9th house highlights a review of beliefs, legal matters, travel plans or higher education. Your mind is pulled between immediate details and broader narratives.

💼 Career: The 3rd–9th house activation is excellent for revising presentations, contracts, reports and training materials. With Mercury retrograde, go back over something you thought was settled—terms with a client, the scope of a project, or the structure of a course. You’re likely to spot assumptions that need updating. Meetings today may reveal differing expectations, especially with partners or collaborators (Jupiter in your 7th); approach these as opportunities to clarify, not to win. Writing, teaching, and strategy work are especially favoured.

❤️ Love: Communication is the main arena for connection. With the Moon in your 3rd, small interactions—how you greet each other, the quality of your replies, the attention you give to messages—matter more than big gestures. If partnered, you may talk about future plans involving travel, study or shared projects abroad. If single, you could feel drawn to someone who stimulates your mind and broadens your outlook, possibly met through a class, online discussion or legal/academic setting. Pay attention to whether their words and actions align over time.

💰 Money: The 3rd house can bring a flurry of small expenses linked to commuting, devices, subscriptions and skills training. The Virgo 9th-house Sun–Mercury phase is ideal for examining larger-scale financial commitments tied to education, legal matters, or overseas plans. You may decide to restructure a payment plan, delay a course, or look for more grounded ways to fund an aspiration. Jupiter in your 7th reminds you that fair, transparent agreements with others are key to long-term stability.

🧘 Advice: Speak and write today as if what you’re putting into words will shape your next chapter—because in subtle ways, it will.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The clarification you insist on now may feel minor, but it can prevent an entire storyline of future stress.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon remains in sidereal Pisces in your 2nd house of money, speech and personal values, ruled by Jupiter in Cancer in your 6th. This links your sense of security to how you manage work, service and health routines. Saturn, your ancient ruler, continues to press for realistic priorities. The Sun with retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 8th house of shared resources, obligations and psychological depth pushes you to look more closely at entanglements—financial and emotional.

💼 Career: With the 2nd and 6th houses activated, your attention naturally turns to how your daily efforts translate into tangible rewards. You may realise that certain tasks consume disproportionate time for little actual benefit, or that a more organised approach could improve reliability and income. The Virgo 8th-house Sun–Mercury suggests revisiting contracts, benefits, tax matters or consultancy agreements: ask the questions you’ve been postponing about compensation, equity, or responsibilities. This is a day for clear, grounded conversations rather than vague reassurances.

❤️ Love: The 2nd–8th house focus brings up themes of worth and sharing in relationships. If partnered, topics such as how expenses are divided, who handles which financial responsibilities, or how transparent you both are about money may surface. Approach these discussions as joint problem-solving rather than score-keeping. If single, you might suddenly see a pattern in your past choices around partners—perhaps tolerating inconsistency if someone seemed “exciting” or overlooking red flags around responsibility. Use that insight to refine what you’re truly available for now.

💰 Money: Pisces in your 2nd can make you both generous and slightly blurry about boundaries, especially when others need help. Jupiter in the 6th reminds you that sustainable giving arises from a stable foundation. The Virgo 8th-house activation favours meticulously going through shared accounts, insurance, debts, or subscription-based services. You don’t need to overhaul everything; identifying and adjusting one or two key arrangements can significantly ease pressure.

🧘 Advice: Let your financial decisions today reflect not only what you can manage in the moment, but what will keep you steady six months from now.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The limit you set around one practical matter today is an act of care for your future self, not a sign of selfishness.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon continues through your own sign in sidereal Pisces, still in your 1st house and moving through your natural terrain of sensitivity and imagination. Ruled by Jupiter in Cancer in your 5th, this heightens creative impulses and a desire to live from the heart. At the same time, the Sun with retrograde Mercury in Virgo in your 7th house of partnerships keeps reflection on close relationships and agreements very active. You’re at an energetic pivot point between tending to your own needs and adjusting how you show up with others.

💼 Career: With the Moon in your 1st, your presence is more noticeable in professional spaces; people may look to you for emotional attunement, inspiration or intuitive guidance. Jupiter in your 5th encourages you to infuse your work with originality—whether through creative ideas, mentoring others or bringing warmth to problem-solving. The Virgo 7th-house Sun–Mercury retrograde is ideal for reassessing contracts, client relationships or collaborations: are the expectations clear? Do they allow you to bring your best qualities without overextending? Today favours renegotiation based on self-respect, not withdrawal.

❤️ Love: With your 1st and 7th houses lit, relationship themes are strong. If partnered, you may feel both more sensitive and more aware of where dynamics need fine-tuning. This can be a beautiful day for honest, specific conversations about how you each feel supported or unseen. Try using concrete examples rather than vague complaints. If single, your magnetism is quietly high, but Saturn’s broader influence on your sign reminds you to let people reveal their consistency over time. You’re better off investing in those who respect your emotional depth rather than those who only enjoy its surface.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 5th can incline you to generous spending on loved ones, creative projects or experiences, while the Moon in your 1st may increase emotional impulses. The Virgo 7th-house emphasis suggests that financial decisions tied to others—shared purchases, joint ventures, promises to “sort it out later”—deserve clear structure. Use today to articulate your limits and preferences, even in small things like splitting bills or choosing venues; this builds a healthier pattern.

🧘 Advice: Let your empathy extend to yourself today; adjust one agreement or habit so that it honours both your sensitivity and your time.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you calmly state what works for you in one important connection now becomes a quiet turning point in how you relate to everyone.
